Notification.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude needs your attention" with title "Claude Code"'

PostToolUse.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && [ -n "$FILE" ] && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true
FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && [ -n "$FILE" ] && [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(js|ts|jsx|tsx)$ ]] && npx eslint --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true
FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ] && git add "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true

PreToolUse.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty') && if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(\.env|\.lock|secrets\.yaml|credentials|id_rsa|\.pem)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot modify protected file: $FILE" >&2; exit 2; fi

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty') && if echo "$CMD" | grep -qEi '(rm\s+-rf\s+/|DROP\s+TABLE|DROP\s+DATABASE|mkfs\.|:\(\)\{|chmod\s+-R\s+777\s+/|dd\s+if=.*of=/dev/)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected: $CMD" >&2; exit 2; fi
